items.summary: Malik Davis suffered a hip injury during Friday practice. Dallas ruled him out for Week 1, and COO Stephen Jones called it a pretty serious injury that could keep him out for some period of time. The Cowboys' official report says he is likely to be out much longer than Sunday, although final details are pending.
items.fantasy_significance: Davis was JD's contingent-upside RB4 and is not in the current Week 1 starting lineup. The injury makes him JD's weakest current bench asset pending a firm diagnosis and creates an urgent opportunity to recycle the roster spot during the free-pickup window.

recommendation.cost: $0 only if Yahoo confirms a candidate is available before the Week 1 free-pickup window closes.
recommendation.why: Davis is out for Week 1 and likely longer, eliminating the immediate contingent value for which JD rostered him. Demercado now has the clearest path to the Dallas No. 2 RB job.
recommendation.urgency: HIGH — check Yahoo now, but do not execute an add/drop until availability is verified.
recommendation.confidence: HIGH that Davis is unavailable Week 1; MEDIUM-HIGH that he misses additional time; MEDIUM on Demercado as the initial replacement; NONE on Sparta availability.
recommendation.roster_comparison: Malik Davis is now JD's weakest current roster asset because of the significant injury. No lineup change is required because he was already on the Week 1 bench.
